sentences.en: Salt was a rare and costly commodity in ancient times.
sentences.zh: 在古代，盐是一种稀有且昂贵的商品。

sentences.en: It is costly and politically difficult to continue this conflict.
sentences.zh: 继续这场冲突代价高昂且政治上困难重重。

sentences.en: It had been very costly in lives, money, and supplies.
sentences.zh: 这在人员、资金和物资方面都付出了巨大的代价。

senses.zh: 昂贵的，花钱多的；代价高昂的，造成损失的
